- SOC 2: we'll need the full SOC 2 Type II report or an auditor attestation with the scope. The executive summary is helpful; can you confirm availability of the full report under an NDA?
- GDPR/HIPAA: Vastly handles PHI in a subset of workloads; we need confirmation that Redwood supports BAA/HIPAA controls for Private/Dedicated deployments. Can you route that to legal?
- Vendor questionnaire: attached is our vendor security questionnaire (vendor_questionnaire_vastly.xlsx). Please fill what you can and mark anything that needs a call. [Attachment: vendor_questionnaire_vastly.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Technical asks for Dev:
- SCIM: we use SCIM 2.0 with a couple custom attributes (vst:employee_type, vst:entitlements). Can you share your SCIM schema and confirm support for delta and bulk provisioning?
- SSO: we use SAML 2.0 via IdP-initiated flows. Do you support SP-initiated as well? Do you publish metadata endpoint / provide a metadata XML?
- RBAC: we need to know available roles and whether we can map SAML attributes into roles.

Scheduling: Friday 9/18 9:30 AM PT works for our security engineer (I've cc'd vendor-security). If you can confirm a 30-minute slot we'll send a calendar invite.

Hi Alex — thanks for the detail. I'm Dev (solutions engineering) — looping on technicals and happy to run the Friday session. Answers below and attached samples: scim-schema.json and sso-metadata.xml.

Summary answers (short):
- SOC 2 full report: Please note Marissa attached the executive summary; we can share the full SOC 2 Type II report under a standard NDA. Legal/Compliance is prepared to provide the report — Marissa, I can coordinate.
- HIPAA/BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-covered deployments for Private/Dedicated customers; we have a BAA template we can share for signature. I'll add legal on the follow-up if you want the template now.

SSO / SAML
- Protocol: SAML 2.0 supported. We support both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows.
- Metadata: we can provide an XML metadata file (attached: sso-metadata.xml) or a metadata URL on our tenant.
- Attribute mapping: SAML attribute mapping into RBAC roles is configurable in the Console (map attribute -> role).

SCIM provisioning
- Version: SCIM 2.0 (RFC7644) supported. We support full CRUD, delta changes (sync token), and bulk provisioning endpoints.
- Auth: Bearer token (provisioning token) scoped to the tenant; tokens rotate.
- Schema: Attached scim-schema.json includes our core attributes and an example extension for vendor-specific fields. The example includes handling for vst:employee_type and vst:entitlements.

RBAC and admin controls
- Default roles: Admin, Developer, Viewer.
- Custom roles: Customers can create custom roles and map SAML attributes to grant roles automatically during SSO.
- Admin controls: Multi-admin workflows, audit logs (console + export), and time-limited elevation via the Console.

Attachments included: scim-schema.json, sso-metadata.xml, redwood-console-admin-screenshot.png (screenshots of role mapping UI).

Test tenant
We can provision a temporary test tenant for your security engineer to validate SSO/SCIM. Typical process: share SP metadata or metadata URL -> we configure test tenant -> you initiate provisioning from IdP -> we confirm user provisioning and role mapping.

I'll join the Fri 9/18 9:30 AM PT call. Please send the calendar invite and any questions you want us to cover.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
